phrases.text: The Inevitable Hour
What is the Inevitable Hour
And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is
˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster
As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His statement, exalted is He: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ ("As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overwhelming [calamity] (al-ṭāghiya)") (5).

phrases.text: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind
phrases.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

phrases.text: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days,
so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
Do you see any of them left alive
Also, Pharaoh and those before him,
phrases.ar: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ
phrases.head: Explanation of the word of the Exalted: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ ("And Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the overturned cities, with sin") (69:9).

phrases.text: and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin
each disobeying their Lord’s messenger,
so He seized them with a crushing grip
Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺
so that We may make this a reminder to you,
and that attentive ears may grasp it
At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast
phrases.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His statement, the Exalted: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ (13) ("And when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast (13)").

phrases.text: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow
on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass
The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail
with the angels on its sides.
On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them
phrases.ar: وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ

phrases.text: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺,
and none of your secrets will stay hidden
As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺!
phrases.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His statement, the Exalted: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ (19) ("As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say: Here, read my book (19)").

phrases.text: Read my record
I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”
They will be in a life of bliss
in an elevated Garden
whose fruit will hang within reach
˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”
And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record
phrases.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ

phrases.text: nor known anything of my reckoning
I wish death was the end
My wealth has not benefited me
My authority has been stripped from me.”
˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them
then burn them in Hell
then tie them up with chains seventy arms long
For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest
phrases.ar: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

phrases.text: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His statement, exalted is He: وَلا يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ ("And he did not urge the feeding of the needy") (34).

phrases.text: So this Day they will have no close friend here
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, the Exalted: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ (35) ("So today he has here no devoted friend (35)").

phrases.text: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus
which none will eat except the evildoers.”
Now, I do swear by whatever you see
phrases.head:
The statement concerning the explanation of His word, the Exalted: فَلا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
("But no, I swear by what you see")

phrases.text: and whatever you cannot see
Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger
It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith
phrases.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ

phrases.text: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
phrases.head: The explanation of the statement of the Exalted: "A sending down from the Lord of the worlds" (69:43).

phrases.text: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name
We would have certainly seized him by his right hand
then severed his aorta
and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺
phrases.ar: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His statement, exalted is He: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ ("Then none of you could have withheld [Us] from him") (47).

phrases.text: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺
And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial
and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers
And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth
So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
